claim: Every connected simple triangle-free cubic three-attachment small side has a strictly smaller simple triangle-free gadget with three attachment incidences, all internal degrees completed to three, and exactly the same external-neighbor B-homomorphism relation.
counterexample: K2,3 with its three degree-two ports
smaller_gadgets: only the one-vertex three-stub star; order3 would be a triangle, other smaller orders impossible by parity
does_not_reject: one-way star lifting with extra outside-endpoint conditions; changes to exterior; a larger local replacement
